LanguageData.CK.Robotics.MkVCombat.Disengage.Desc: Stop fighting immediately and return to the assembly bay or nearest charging station.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Toggle.Sweep.Label: Sweep
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Toggle.Sweep.Desc: Clean filth inside the home area (dirt, blood, vomit and so on).
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Toggle.Scrub.Label: Scrub
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Toggle.Scrub.Desc: Clean filth outside the home area, such as after a raid. Turn this off to keep the robot inside the base.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Toggle.Haul.Label: Haul
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Toggle.Haul.Desc: Carry loose items to stockpiles. Corpses are ignored.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Command.Charge.Desc: Go to the nearest powered station and charge to full.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.NoStation: No powered charging station is available.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Inspect.Idle: All chores are disabled; the robot will only stand by.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Inspect.Downed: The robot is shut down, waiting to be repaired or dismantled.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Station.Assemble.Desc: Assemble one nanny robot at this station. A destroyed robot must wait for the cooldown.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.MkVBay.Start.Desc: Consume the dedicated recipe and start one Mk-V assembly. Recipe: {0}. The bay draws working power until the robot is complete.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.MkVBay.Cancel.Desc: Stop the current assembly. Consumed materials are not refunded.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.MkVBay.AlreadyWorking: The bay is already assembling a Mk-V.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.MkVBay.MissingResearch: Complete the Mk-V integration project and all seven subsystem projects first.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.MkVBay.NoPower: The assembly bay has no power.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.MkVBay.MissingIngredients: Not enough materials to start assembly.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.MkVBay.Cancelled: Mk-V assembly cancelled. Materials are not refunded.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.MkVBay.InspectResearch: Waiting for the Mk-V integration research.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Station.HasRobot: The station already has a robot.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Station.Ready: Ready to assemble a nanny robot.
